::: {#rem-prediction-mse}
#### Prediction sMSE, estimator pMSE and RSS

@def-prediction-mse averages squared errors over observations,
where the [pMSE of an estimator](estimation.qmd#def-mse)
takes an expectation over repeated samples.
On the data used to fit the model,
the sMSE of the fitted values is the
[residual sum of squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-rss)
divided by $n$
([sMSE and RSS](correlation-regression.qmd#thm-mse-rss)):

$$\sMSE{\fitted} = \frac{1}{n} \text{RSS}(\est{\vparam}),
\qquad
\text{RSS}(\est{\vparam}) = n \, \sMSE{\fitted}.$$
:::
